items.title: Last day to cancel the electricity contract without notice period (before new prices apply)
items.quote: Wenn Sie mit der Anpassung nicht einverstanden sind, können Sie Ihren Liefervertrag fristlos auf den Tag kündigen, an dem die neuen Preise gelten (§ 41 Abs. 5 EnWG).
items.computation: New prices apply from 01.08.2025. The letter allows termination without notice effective on that day, so the cancellation must reach the provider by then. The date is printed, so no period counting is needed. A cancellation by email is sufficient. Sending it earlier is safer, because 01.08.2025 is a Friday and the cancellation must be received by then.

warnings: The letter does not say by which day the cancellation must be received; 2025-08-01 is taken from the date the new prices apply, so send the email well before then and keep proof of sending.
